title: 彭博：伊朗战争阴影下，北约峰会何去何从？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Dan Williams is in Middle East reporter for Bloomberg News. He joins us today from London.
segments.zh: 丹·威廉姆斯是彭博新闻社的中东记者，今天从伦敦加入我们。

segments.en: Dan, great to see you as always. And let me pick up on something that Lisa mentioned just a moment ago.
segments.zh: 丹，很高兴再次见到你。我想接着丽莎刚才提到的话题。

segments.en: That is the phone calls that the president received yesterday from President Zelensky and President Putin as well. He had a lot of time to fill as he waited for the events to unfold in Washington, D.C. It seems.
segments.zh: 那就是总统昨天接到的泽连斯基和普京的电话。他在等待华盛顿事件展开时，似乎有很多时间要打发。

segments.en: But set the table for us for this NATO summit scheduled to start on Tuesday. And I look at what the goals are as set out by NATO, defense investment, defense industry and support for Ukraine. What can we expect when that summit gets underway in Turkey?
segments.zh: 但请为我们梳理一下周二开始的北约峰会。北约设定的目标包括国防**、国防工业和对乌克兰的支持。在土耳其举行的峰会上，我们能期待什么？

segments.en: You noted very well the summary, the agenda for that meeting. I think it's also worth noting that it's being hosted by Turkey. Turkey has the second biggest military in NATO after the United States.
segments.zh: 你很好地总结了会议议程。值得注意的是，峰会由土耳其主办，土耳其拥有北约第二大军事力量，仅次于美国。

segments.en: And we have a US president who's quite openly looking to draw down the US presence in NATO, the US contribution. Certainly when it comes to Europe, that's something that's really troubled European
segments.zh: 而美国总统相当公开地希望减少美国在北约的存在和贡献。在欧洲方面，这确实让欧洲大国感到不安。

segments.en: powers, not least, given what is perceived as a rather warm approach that Trump has been taking to the Russian president, Putin. So they will continue discussions we've seen from previous Trump
segments.zh: 尤其是考虑到特朗普对俄罗斯总统普京的态度被认为相当温和。他们将延续之前特朗普政府关于负担分担的讨论。

segments.en: administration, the previous Trump administration, previous years in which he's been president about burden sharing. How much of the GDP of European partner countries should be dedicated to
segments.zh: 欧洲伙伴国应将多少GDP用于国防，以减轻美国的主导贡献？特朗普始终关注的是底线。

segments.en: defense in order to relieve the really large dominant US contribution to that? The bottom dollar is something Trump is always looking at. I think unstated but certainly present in the room
segments.zh: 我认为未明说但确实存在于会场的是，特朗普的底线思维。
